pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with jagged, stellate extensions. Edge gradients are diffuse due to image resolution/blur. Individual patches on the mid-flank are larger and more angular than those on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative space forms a interconnected lattice of thin, cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-shaped). Pathway thickness is significantly narrower than patch diameter, maintaining continuity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal ridge of the neck displays a low-amplitude serrated silhouette with a dense, high-frequency frequency of fine hair tips visible against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized area of disrupted texture and lighter pigmentation is visible on the lower neck/shoulder transition, where the typical patch-and-corridor geometry is replaced by a broader, amorphous light region.

other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast disruption in the patch pattern occurs on the lower right quadrant of the neck, appearing as an oversized, irregularly shaped white junction node.
